title: A measure reference in a calculated column is filtered to the current row

source.quote: There is a row context because the code is that of a calculated column
source.supports: the article's calculated column Customer[Sales] = [Sales Amount] has a row context and a hidden CALCULATE, so the transition happens

source.quote: The result of Sales 2 is the amount of sales to all customers, whereas the result of Sales 1 is the amount of sales to the current customer only.
source.supports: the measure reference gives the sales of the current customer only

notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
